data.name: W.A.R. HANGRY
data.detailed_description:
Please note:

The images shown on the Steam page are placeholders and will be updated as development progresses! 

🍽️ Feed & Digest
Fuel your energy: eat seafood, nap, or poop to avoid fainting and food comas.

🐟 Edible Ammo
Devour or launch seafood to heal yourself or KO opponents.

🔧 Weapon Crafting
Forge seafood launchers from trash—straws to 3D-printed cannons.

♻️ Eco Bar
Collect recyclables to fill your Eco Bar, earning shop discounts and delaying predator attacks.

🪿 Bird Support
Feed and command seabirds to blind foes with aerial poop drops.

🦈 Predator Vulnerability
Faint or coma and face ambushing predators or a last-chance Kraken duel.

🐋 Whale Train
Ride whales—blowholes and tails launch you, but stray into their mouths to be swallowed and spat out.

🧊 Shrinking Arena
Melting ice, toxic seas, and choking air close in—last penguin standing wins.

And MUCH more to come! 🐧

data.short_description: Free-to-play third-person battle royale where evolved penguins manage hunger, scavenge food, craft seafood launchers, and survive hangry predators in a shrinking, polluted ocean.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Drivers: Ensure that graphics drivers are up to date for best performance. Multiplayer: A stable and fast internet connection is recommended for multiplayer.
